CommandEntry.description: One entry in the command palette.

action.description:
Keymap action name, when the entry is a keymap action. With `index`
for indexed actions (`switch_tab` + 3).

chords.description: Current bindings on this platform, in config syntax (`cmd+d`).

id.description:
Stable id: the keymap action name (`split_right`, `switch_tab_3`), or
the method name for commands no key is bound to (`browser.open`).

method.description:
The protocol method it sends, if any; `None` for shell-only actions
(palette, sidebar, find…).

needs_tile.description: Acts on the focused tile, so the palette greys it out without one.

planned.description: Not supported yet; shown greyed out.

prompt.description:
Needs input before it can run (a URL, a path, a name): the palette
prompts for `prompt` first.

ConfigDiagnostic.description: A problem in the config file, for the shell's banner.

applied.description: False when the new file had errors: the previous config stays.

Created.description: IDs of what a command created; only the relevant fields are set.

oneOf.description: The request wasn't valid JSON.
Valid JSON, but not a request (e.g. no `method`).
A window, workspace, tab or tile doesn't exist.
The command doesn't apply right now (nothing focused, no neighbour that way…).
Not available in this build or configuration.

Event.description: Something that changed in the core.

oneOf.description: Frame or sidebar changed.
Name, cwd or herdr binding changed.
A window's workspaces changed order.
A workspace's tabs changed order.
A tile's title or content changed (e.g. a terminal got its herdr pane).

A tile closed. `kill` asks the herdr adapter to kill the terminal's pane
rather than detach from it.

A terminal tile's agent started or stopped needing a look: it became
blocked or finished, or someone focused the tile (F11). Also visible as
`tile.agent.attention` on `tile.updated`.
A tab's tree, focused tile or zoom changed.
The focused window, workspace, tab or tile changed.

A preview tile's file was (re)rendered: on open, on restore and after
every change on disk. Not saved; `preview.get` returns the latest.

The core's link to herdr came up or dropped. After `connected: true`,
shells reattach terminal tiles that gave up waiting. Not saved.

The agent in a terminal tile changed state, as herdr reports it (F16).
Not saved.

The config file changed on disk and was read again (F25b). When it has
errors the previous config stays and `applied` is false. Not saved.

EventNotification.description: An event plus the subscription it's for: the event's own `event` and `data` fields, and `subscription`.

EventsSubscribe.description:
Parameters of `events.subscribe`. Every filter is optional; together they
narrow the stream (an event must pass all of them).

tile.description:
Only events about this tile: its own `tile.*`, `preview.updated` and
`agent.state_changed` events, layout changes of its tab, and focus
changes to or from it.

workspace.description:
Only events about this workspace: its own events, its tabs' and its
tiles', and `focus.changed` when focus lands in it. Events about no
particular workspace (`herdr.status`, window events) are left out.

Focus.description: Where the user's focus is. Inner fields are `None` when that level is empty.

Frame.description: A window's frame on screen, in points, origin top left of the main display.

HerdrRef.description:
The herdr pane a terminal tile views. Both IDs are kept: herdr changes a
pane's ID when it moves to another workspace, while the terminal ID is what
`herdr terminal attach` takes. The tab ID matters because closing a herdr
tab reports only the tab, and herdr keeps pane and tab IDs (but not the
process) across a server restart.

base_dir.description:
What relative `cwd` and `path` values in the file resolve against.
Defaults to the file's directory, or the workspace's cwd for `toml`.

path.description: A layout file (`.azulejo.toml`). Give exactly one of `path` and `toml`.

workspace.description: For `new_tab` and `replace_tab`; the focused workspace by default.

path.description:
Also write the file here. Paths in it are made relative to its
directory where they're inside it.

tab.description: Export one tab. Without it, the whole workspace.

workspace.description: The workspace to export; the focused one by default.

amount.description: Share of the enclosing split to move the edge by. Defaults to 0.05.

content.description: The new tile; defaults to a terminal.

direction.description: Which side of `tile` the new tile goes.

tile.description: The tile to split; defaults to the focused one.

direction.description: Swap with the neighbour this way. Give exactly one of `direction`, `with`.

with.description: Swap with this tile, which must be in the same tab.

Node.description: One node of a layout tree.

ratio.description: Share of the space given to `a`, in (0, 1).

Notification.description:
A message the server sends without being asked, on a connection with a
subscription. On the wire it's a JSON-RPC notification: `method` plus
`params`.

oneOf.description: One event. `event` and `data` are exactly the event's own fields.

The subscriber fell behind and `dropped` events were skipped just
before the next one it receives.

OnExit.description:
What happens to a terminal tile when the process in its pane exits
(`exit`, ctrl+d, a finished command). Config `[terminal] on_exit`; a tile
can override it (layout files' `on_exit`).

oneOf.description: The tile closes, like any terminal window whose shell exits.
The tile stays, ended, offering Respawn or Close.

html.description:
A complete HTML document for the tile's webview; absent for native
kinds. When the tile already shows `path`, pass it to
`azulejoPreview.swap(html)` (shared/webview/preview.js) to keep the
scroll position.

revision.description:
Counts renders of this tile in this run, so a shell can drop stale
updates.

truncated.description: Only the start of a very large file was rendered.

oneOf.description:
Native kinds: the shell shows `path` with QuickLook (macOS) or GTK
(Linux); there's no `html`.
